title: Path24 species phylogeny
legend: Topology-only view of the supplied 24-tip Path24 tree, retaining canonical species rows. Source publication and calibration provenance are unresolved, so branch lengths and time axes are omitted. Development mode is described in the caption: 22 species have aquatic larvae and undergo metamorphosis; D. aeneus and D. wrighti are direct developers. D. organi is absent and not imputed. This is descriptive, not a development-mode test.

title: Estimated genome size
legend: Estimated genome sizes in pg/1C for Path24, derived from IOD and anchored to the D. fuscus assembly, with released conditional measurement intervals and original phylogenetic row order. Numbers label estimates to one decimal; the 8-27 pg/1C axis retains every interval endpoint. The estimates are not independent species C-values and intervals do not include uncertainty in the anchor.

title: Reviewed nucleus area
legend: Reviewed species nucleus-area estimates in square micrometres, with released measurement intervals, for all 24 Path24 species in the original phylogenetic row order. Numbers label estimates to one decimal; the 35-55 square micrometre axis retains every interval endpoint. The plot is descriptive and preserves variation in the underlying measurement support.
